metadata.article_title: Salaries, allowances and other terms and conditions of service of President and members of District Commission.

article.title: Salaries, allowances and other terms and conditions of service of President and members of District Commission.
article.content: The State Government may, by notification, make rules to provide for salaries and allowances and other terms and conditions of service of the President, and members of the District Commission.
article.html:
30Salaries, allowances and other terms and conditions of service of President and members of District Commission.

Section 30 · Chapter IV · page 18 of the Act

The State Government may, by notification, make rules to provide for salaries and allowances and other terms and conditions of service of the President, and members of the District Commission.
